{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
name: Build Flatpak
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  flatpak:
    name: "build-packages"
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    container:
      image: bilelmoussaoui/flatpak-github-actions:gnome-47
      options: --privileged
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
    - name: Free space for the Wine SDK
      run: |
        rm -rf /__t/CodeQL /__t/Python /__t/PyPy
        df -h "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
    - uses: bilelmoussaoui/flatpak-github-actions/flatpak-builder@v6
      with:
        bundle: bottles.flatpak
        manifest-path: build-aux/com.usebottles.bottles.Devel.json
        cache-key: flatpak-builder-x86_64-${{ hashFiles('build-aux/com.usebottles.bottles.Devel.json') }}
    - name: Test multiarch runtime
      run: |
        curl -fL https://deb.debian.org/debian/pool/main/g/gstreamer1.0/gstreamer1.0-tools_1.26.2-2_i386.deb -o /tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386.deb
        echo 'cca853f66856ec889891e3d509786c3fd7169469a5c92c7751851e53b2b9fa3c  /tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386.deb' | sha256sum -c -
        mkdir /tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386
        cd /tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386
        ar x /tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386.deb data.tar.xz
        tar -xf data.tar.xz
        curl -fL https://github.com/bottlesdevs/wine/releases/download/soda-11.0-10/soda-11.0-10-x86_64.tar.xz -o /tmp/soda.tar.xz
        echo '14633fabd180d308d2c1ebcb84a16f36d0484dded5809c64f8a7c93e654d7296  /tmp/soda.tar.xz' | sha256sum -c -
        mkdir /tmp/soda
        tar -xJf /tmp/soda.tar.xz -C /tmp/soda
        flatpak remote-add --user --if-not-exists flathub https://dl.flathub.org/repo/flathub.flatpakrepo
        install_ref() {
          attempts=0
          until flatpak install --user --noninteractive flathub "$1"; do
            attempts=$((attempts + 1))
            test "$attempts" -lt 5 || return 1
            sleep $((attempts * 5))
          done
        }
        install_ref org.freedesktop.Platform.Compat.i386//25.08
        install_ref org.freedesktop.Platform.codecs_extra.i386//25.08-extra
        flatpak install --user --noninteractive "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/bottles.flatpak"
        xvfb-run -a flatpak run --user --command=bottles com.usebottles.bottles.Devel --help
        flatpak run --user --command=sh com.usebottles.bottles.Devel -ec '
          grep -Fx /app/lib32 /app/etc/ld.so.conf
          grep -Fx /app/lib/i386-linux-gnu/codecs-extra/lib /app/etc/ld.so.conf
          grep -Fx /app/lib/i386-linux-gnu /app/etc/ld.so.conf
          test -r /app/lib/i386-linux-gnu/libc.so.6
          test -d /app/lib/i386-linux-gnu/dri/intel-vaapi-driver
          test -d /app/i386/nvidia-vaapi-driver
          test -r /app/share/bottles/bottles/backend/managers/eagletracing.py
          test -r /app/share/bottles/bottles/backend/identity.py
          python3 -c "from gi.repository import Gio; resource = Gio.Resource.load(\"/app/share/bottles/bottles.gresource\"); ui = resource.lookup_data(\"/com/usebottles/bottles/details-preferences.ui\", Gio.ResourceLookupFlags.NONE).get_data(); assert b\"switch_eagle_tracing\" in ui"
          gst-inspect-1.0 avdec_wmv3
        '
        if flatpak info --user com.usebottles.bottles.Devel.Debug; then
          flatpak uninstall --user --noninteractive com.usebottles.bottles.Devel.Debug
        fi
        install_ref org.freedesktop.Platform.GL32.Debug.default//25.08
        flatpak run --user --command=sh com.usebottles.bottles.Devel -ec '
          test -d /app/lib/GL32.Debug/default
          test -n "$(find /app/lib/GL32.Debug/default -type f -print -quit)"
        '
        flatpak run --user \
          --filesystem=/tmp/soda:ro \
          --command=sh \
          com.usebottles.bottles.Devel -ec '
            export WINEDEBUG=-all
            export WINEPREFIX=/tmp/soda-prefix
            runner=/tmp/soda/soda-11.0-10-x86_64/bin/wine
            wineserver=/tmp/soda/soda-11.0-10-x86_64/bin/wineserver
            timeout 120 "$runner" wineboot -u
            timeout 30 "$runner" "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/windows/system32/cmd.exe" /c exit
            timeout 30 "$runner" "$WINEPREFIX/drive_c/windows/syswow64/cmd.exe" /c exit
            "$wineserver" -k
          '
        flatpak run --user \
          --filesystem=/tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386:ro \
          --command=/tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386/usr/bin/gst-inspect-1.0 \
          com.usebottles.bottles.Devel avdec_wmv3
        flatpak run --user \
          --filesystem=/tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386:ro \
          --command=/tmp/gstreamer-tools-i386/usr/bin/gst-inspect-1.0 \
          com.usebottles.bottles.Devel avdec_wmapro
",
  "rationale": "Two evidence-supported optimizations are applied: (1) The flatpak-builder cache-key is changed from using the commit SHA (which changes every run) to a hash of the manifest file, enabling cache reuse when the manifest hasn't changed. This follows the pattern demonstrated in the measured CI workflow experiment (experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) where hashFiles of a dependency file is used for cache keys, and aligns with the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern for caching dependency downloads. (2) Concurrency control is added to cancel superseded runs on the same branch/PR, reducing duplicate work. This matches the P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE pattern which shows estimated VM time reductions of 1.9% (free) and 4.1% (paid) by canceling superseded runs. Both changes preserve all build and test coverage, require no new permissions or network access, and are minimal modifications to the existing workflow.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
